t2.title: It important for young people to follow fashion trends
t2.prompt: A student magazine announced an article writing contest. The best ones will be published in the magazine. Write your article on this topic: "Is it important for young people to follow fashion trends?" Write 180–200 words, giving reasons and examples.
t2.sample:
Private Tutoring vs Self-Study: What Works Best?

This debate is increasingly relevant as tutoring costs rise. Having experienced both approaches, here's my perspective.

Firstly, private tutoring offers personalized attention. A good tutor can identify knowledge gaps and adapt explanations to your learning style.

Moreover, tutors provide accountability and structure. Regular sessions create a routine that many students need to stay on track.

However, self-study develops independent learning skills that are essential for university and beyond. Students who can motivate themselves often become lifelong learners.

Additionally, with quality online resources now freely available, self-directed learning is more accessible than ever.

Ultimately, the best approach depends on the student. Tutoring can be a valuable supplement, but it shouldn't replace developing self-reliance.

What's your experience with tutoring versus independent study?

t2.sampleB2:
Fashion: Fitting In or Standing Out?

Walk into any school and you will spot the latest trainers, phone and hairstyle within seconds. But is keeping up with fashion really that important for young people? In my opinion, though, it matters far less than most people think. On the one hand, following trends does have its upsides. Wearing what everyone else is wearing can help teenagers fit in and feel part of the crowd, which boosts their confidence. Trends can also be a fun way to express your personality and stay in the loop with what is happening around you. On the other hand, chasing every new trend comes at a price. Fashion changes at lightning speed, so keeping up can quickly drain your wallet. Worse still, it can put huge pressure on those who cannot afford the latest brands. Personally, I believe young people should wear whatever makes them feel comfortable and confident, rather than blindly copying others just to keep up. Real style comes from within, not from a label. At the end of the day, trends come and go, but being true to yourself never goes out of fashion.
t2.uzSample:
Xususiy repetitorlik va mustaqil o'qish: Nima yaxshiroq ishlaydi?

Bu bahs, repetitorlik narxlari oshib borayotgani sababli, tobora dolzarb bo'lib bormoqda. Ikkala yondashuvni ham boshdan kechirganimdan so'ng, mening nuqtai nazarim quyidagicha.

Birinchidan, xususiy repetitorlik shaxsiy e'tiborni taklif etadi. Yaxshi repetitor bilimdagi kamchiliklarni aniqlashi va tushuntirishlarni sizning o'rganish uslubingizga moslashtirishi mumkin.

Bundan tashqari, repetitorlar hisobdorlik va tuzilmani ta'minlaydi. Muntazam mashg'ulotlar ko'plab talabalarga yo'lda qolish uchun zarur bo'lgan tartibni yaratadi.

Biroq, mustaqil o'qish universitet va undan keyingi hayot uchun zarur bo'lgan mustaqil o'rganish ko'nikmalarini rivojlantiradi. O'zini o'zi rag'batlantira oladigan talabalar ko'pincha umrbod o'rganuvchilarga aylanadi.

Bundan tashqari, hozirda sifatli onlayn manbalar bepul mavjudligi sababli, o'z-o'zini boshqaruvchi ta'lim har qachongidan ham osonroq.

Oxir oqibat, eng yaxshi yondashuv talabaga bog'liq. Repetitorlik qimmatli qo'shimcha bo'lishi mumkin, ammo u o'ziga ishonchni rivojlantirish o'rnini bosmasligi kerak.

Repetitorlik va mustaqil o'qish bo'yicha sizning tajribangiz qanday?

Hurmatli TutorPro qo'llab-quvvatlash jamoasi,

Men sizga o'z o'quv mashg'ulotlarim haqida aytmoqchiman. Umuman olganda, menimcha, ular juda foydali. Mening repetitorim yaxshi va narsalarni yaxshi tushuntiradi. Men uning o'qitish usullaridan mamnunman.

Biroq, menimcha, agar biz ko'proq amaliyot imtihonlarini qilsak, yaxshiroq bo'lardi. Misol uchun, biz har ikki haftada to'liq imtihon topshirishimiz mumkin. Bu menga nimani kutishni tushunishga yordam beradi, shuningdek, vaqtni boshqarish qobiliyatimni yaxshilaydi. Shuningdek, ehtimol, biz men qiynalayotgan sohalarga ko'proq e'tibor qaratishimiz mumkin. Rayhona Karimova
t2.uzSampleB2:
Hurmatli TutorPro qo'llab-quvvatlash jamoasi,

Umid qilamanki, bu xat sizga yaxshi yetib borgan. Men yaqinda o'tgan repetitorlik mashg'ulotlarim bo'yicha fikr-mulohazalarimni bildirish va umumiy o'rganish tajribasini yaxshilashga qaratilgan takliflarni berish uchun yozyapman.

Umuman olganda, men repetitorimning yondashuvidan mamnunman. Ular bilimli va murakkab tushunchalarni aniq va qisqa tarzda tushuntirishga mohir. Biroq, bo'lajak imtihonlarga tayyorgarligimni optimallashtirish uchun o'zgartirishlar kiritish mumkin bo'lgan sohalar bor, deb hisoblayman.

Birinchidan, nazariy bilimlarni amaliy stsenariylarga qo'llashga ko'proq e'tibor qaratilishini xohlardim. Tushuntirishlar to'liq bo'lsa-da, ko'proq real hayotiy misollar va keys-stadilarni kiritish mening tushunishim va eslab qolishimni sezilarli darajada yaxshilaydi. Ikkinchidan, imtihonga xos strategiyalarga, masalan, vaqtni boshqarish usullari va savollarga samarali javob berish yondashuvlariga ko'proq vaqt ajratishni taklif qilaman. Bu meni bosim ostida yaxshi natija ko'rsatish uchun zarur ko'nikmalar bilan ta'minlaydi.

Bundan tashqari, mening taraqqiyotim bo'yicha muntazam ravishda fikr-mulohaza berish va yaxshilanishi kerak bo'lgan aniq sohalarni aniqlash juda qimmatli bo'ladi. Konstruktiv tanqid, moslashtirilgan yo'l-yo'riqlar bilan birgalikda, mening harakatlarimni jamlashimga va yaxshiroq natijalarga erishishimga imkon beradi. Ushbu takliflarni amalga oshirish repetitorlik mashg'ulotlarining samaradorligini sezilarli darajada oshirishiga ishonaman.

Fikr-mulohazalarimni ko'rib chiqqaningiz uchun tashakkur. Sizdan tez orada javob eshitishni umid qilaman.

Hurmat bilan,
Rayhona Karimova

t12.title: formal letter · to recipient
t12.prompt: Write a letter to the tutoring service. Write about your feelings and what you think they should do.
t12.sample:
Dear TutorPro Support Team,

I am writing to share my experience with your tutoring service.

Firstly, my tutor has been exceptionally helpful. Their teaching style is clear, patient, and perfectly adapted to my learning pace.

Moreover, the flexible scheduling allows me to balance studies with other activities effectively.

However, I have some suggestions. Offering recorded sessions for later review would be extremely valuable for revision.

Additionally, providing practice tests and study materials between sessions would help reinforce learning.

Furthermore, a progress tracking feature showing improvement over time could be highly motivating.

Thank you for helping me reach my goals.

Best regards,
A Grateful Student

I am writing to you about my tutoring sessions. I think my tutor is very good and helpful. She explains things well, and I am learning a lot. However, I have a few ideas for improvements.
For example, it would be useful if I could record the sessions, so I can listen to them again later. Also, maybe you could give me more practice tests between the sessions. I think this would help me to remember everything better.

t12.sampleB2: Dear TutorPro Support Team, I am writing to share my thoughts on the tutoring service I have been using to prepare for my exams. On the whole, I am delighted with it. My tutor explains tricky topics clearly and always takes the time to make sure I have understood before moving on. That said, there are a couple of changes that would make the service even better. Firstly, it would be really helpful if you could record the sessions, so that I can go over them again closer to the exam. Secondly, providing short practice tests between lessons would let me put what I have learned into practice and pinpoint my weak spots. I am confident these small improvements would benefit many students. Thank you for taking my suggestions on board. Yours sincerely, Dilnoza Karimova
